text:
marcus: Heads-up: eu-south-3 GPU bootstrap failures after this morning's privatelink policy and NAT timeout change. Seeing KMS decrypt errors during init.
nina: Confirmed. ~20% fail rate, kubelet drains nodes. Keystore logs show AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt and some timeouts.
oliver: Redacted log:
```
ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: ExplicitDeny kms:Decrypt for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/edge-bootstrap
at bootstrap/keystore.go:98
```
sre-oncall: Packet trace shows TLS handshake started but then NAT sends RST after ~8s when ephemeral port closed. If the TLS doesn't finish, SDK retries with altered context and KMS may deny. Packet sample: `tcp 10.10.2.4:34567 -> keystore-proxy.eu-south-3:443 RST`.
compliance: We rolled a stricter privatelink endpoint policy to require kms:EncryptionContext:env=prod and a role-boundary to tag principals. That was to lock down dev traffic. I can revert if needed.
marcus: Impact: region GPU pool down ~25%, autoscaler spinning up elsewhere -> cross-region egress and prewarm. Early cost estimate ~2.7k/hr if not fixed. Flagging PG/finance.
nina: Short-term options: 1) revert privatelink policy for eu-south-3 2) rollback NAT keepalive to previous value 3) add temporary Allow for edge-bootstrap role scoped to keystore ARN. Prefer minimal blast: NAT rollback first.
sre-oncall: Agreed. NAT tweak is lowest risk. If that stabilizes, we avoid touching IAM/policies. Schedule a 10m window to flip NAT back to 350s and run canaries.
deploy-bot: NAT rollback for eu-south-3 scheduled in 5m. Will post status and roll ID.
oliver: Also note bootstrap agent is on an older SDK that doesn't consistently set EncryptionContext; long-term we should update client to include required context and add integration test.
compliance: I'll standby to revert endpoint policy if NAT rollback doesn't reduce errors. If we do revert, we'll add an allowlist gate to the policy generator to prevent accidental denies on bootstrap flows.
marcus: Plan: 1) NAT rollback (5m) 2) run 100 canary boots and check keystore logs 3) if failures <5% keep NAT change and schedule client fix 4) else apply temporary IAM allow and iterate with compliance. I'll update the incident doc and ping finance.
sre-oncall: Running canaries after NAT flip. Will update in-thread with success rates.
deploy-bot: NAT rollback executed at 09:12 UTC, roll ID rb-351234. Monitoring canaries.
sre-oncall: Canary results: 100 boots -> 94 successes within 10m. Failures down from 20% -> 6%. Still slightly elevated but much improved.
nina: Good. We'll keep NAT at 350s for now and schedule the bootstrap client update in the next patch window. Also create a test that asserts KMS calls include EncryptionContext.
compliance: Follow-ups: add allowlist gating in policy generator, add an emergency rollback playbook for privatelink policy, and coordinate client rollout.
marcus: Cost note: paused cross-region prewarms. Finance, we'll reconvene if errors persist beyond 30m.
compliance: Thanks, will open a PR with the allowlist change and a postmortem.
sre-oncall: Thread will stay open for 1hr monitoring. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
